jobs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: independent HEADLESS child-body gesture, for the established personalized picture-book character library. The reference is the edit target and anatomy/clothing/style invariant. Keep the EXACT warm yellow sweater with cream chest pocket, sage cuffed shorts, white socks, red canvas sneakers, skin tone, toddler limb and torso proportions, watercolor/gouache paper detail. Change ONLY both arms into a playful rabbit-ear gesture: elbows bend outward, both hands rest just ABOVE an imaginary child's head, with two upright fingers per hand suggesting bunny ears. Hands are empty. The HEAD IS NOT PRESENT: no face, eyes, hair, ears, animal head or placeholder head shape. Allow transparent empty room above the collar for a separately composited head. Crucial geometry: imaginary head height is about 0.47 times collar-to-sole body height; hands must sit around that imaginary crown, and fingers extend above it. Arms remain anatomically plausible; do not shrink torso or legs to accommodate raised hands. Use a tall portrait canvas with ample transparent margin ABOVE the body: collar around 45 percent canvas height, shoes near 95 percent, all raised fingertips around 14 to 25 percent. Preserve the full collar-to-shoe body and both hands with safe margins. Genuine alpha transparency, no colored fringe, glow, floor, cast-shadow blob, prop, writing or watermark. One single body action, no montage.
